scenario.summary: On the grouped PDP, adds the product to the wishlist, checks the toast, clicks the wishlist button again and logs off.
steps: Click the wishlist button; verify 'Product added to your Wishlist.'
Close the toast; click the wishlist button again
stateChanges: The user's wishlist: the grouped product is added (second click toggles it); the user is logged off
assertions: Wishlist toast equals 'Product added to your Wishlist.'
evidence: Method comment: Z10-TC-8871 add to wishlist, Z10-TC-8872 log out.
MessageBoxContainerText is a fixed UI text: expected-output.

This method reuses the head method's signed-in session (wishlist and log-off need it), so it declares the same sheet account; the scan records the credential cells only on the head method, and the same two cells (same location, kind and masking) are declared here from the test source.

DECLARED ACCOUNT (per method): the head method signs in with loginPage.successfullLogin (testClassRetailUsers/groupProductPDPTest Username, Password; loginAndRegistration!B177/C177). An account lease (useExisting) is held by the method that declares it and released when that method ends, so every method that signs in or reuses the signed-in session declares user = USER_WEBSTORE_REGISTERED {store MaxwellsHardware}, preferred {source: its username source, required: true}, with Tda.declareUser at method start. Username/password are credential sources (masked) the test keeps reading from its own sheet.
Scanned constant values (locators, report messages, delays) are framework constants: role config, no need.
